Proposition
[Finite-volume cusp decomposition] 1. Proposition 5.11.1\group thick-thin geometrySource: thurston:page-0128 A complete oriented finite-volume hyperbolic $3$--manifold is the union of a compact submanifold bounded by tori and finitely many rank-two cusps, each a horoball modulo $\Z \oplus \Z $.
Proof

\sketch The thick part is compact: infinitely many separated points would yield infinitely many disjoint balls of a fixed positive volume. Only finitely many thin components meet its compact boundary; absorb the compact ones into the thick part.

□
